== Android web automation sessions

- Automation sessions in Chrome and in app WebViews on Android devices no longer stop responding when a click opens a JavaScript dialog, such as an alert or confirm dialog. Previously, the click command could fail to return, later commands in the session could not run, and ending the session also failed. The device stayed in use until the session was terminated from Kobiton Portal or the API.
- The same fix applies to double taps and to typing commands that tap the element first.
